segments.title: Opening & MIT Mind-Control Device
segments.notes: Case opens the broadcast discussing his impending move and Jon Stewart's Daily Show return; Jeff Ripple joins to cover MIT student Arnav Kapoor's Alter Ego headset that enables internet search via subvocalization and skull-vibration feedback.

segments.title: Hentai vs Furries Debate
segments.notes: Munch argues for furries as a culture; Crum argues hentai's breadth includes furry content. Furries wins the chat poll 78-70; Munch claims the score is rigged and his penis has not been sucked into his stomach.

segments.title: Oklahoma Man: Rattlesnake, Uranium, Whiskey, Firearm
segments.notes: Chet debuts his new theme song and announces 'Chetify' streaming service; covers Stephen Jennings' traffic stop yielding a stolen Ford Explorer, rattlesnake, legal-amount uranium canister, open Kentucky Deluxe whiskey, and firearm. Snake euthanized; uranium charges dropped.

segments.title: Zombies That Hate Breakdancing / Korean Comic TikTok
segments.notes: Attempted coverage of requested 'zombies that hate breakdancing' leads to a silent TikTok of a Korean comic voicing Frozen characters; Case denies it's his algorithm.

segments.title: Don Riggles Roast Session
segments.notes: Don Riggles (imposter Don Rickles) joins via video call and delivers a 30-minute ass-focused roast of Case, Pepito, and chat; plugs fictional tour dates at a checkers factory, Campbell's soup waste plant, and Werther's billiards plantation.

segments.title: Trent at the Movies: Trailers
segments.notes: Trent and Chris watch Monkey Man, Bad vs Wild, Asphalt City, and Borderlands trailers; debate Batman vs Monkey Man, Nick Cannon's progeny, Jack Black as Claptrap, and green-screen aesthetics.

segments.title: Wendy's Surge Pricing Musical Sign-Off
segments.notes: DJ Newsic sings the news from the roof: Wendy's dynamic pricing announced on Q4 2023 earnings call; Baconator price surges at lunch; Hamburglar guest-verse steals and fucks burgers; rate Bruce Green; rain ends stream.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the broadcast, discusses impending move and power turn-on, fields Don Riggles roast, hands off to Trent and DJ Newsic.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Runs cold-open countdown, manages Don Riggles call timing, defends dog literacy against Don's insults.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosts the Alter Ego mind-device segment, debates skull-vibration safety, signs off with ripple metaphor.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argues hentai supremacy over furries, claims chat score is rigged, accuses Munch's penis of retreating into his stomach.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Champions furries as a culture, wins poll 78-70, insists he cannot lose and his penis remains unsucked.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: science correspondent. Debuts 'Macho Macho Chet' theme, announces Chetify streaming platform, covers Oklahoma uranium-snake story, defends legal uranium possession.

characters.name: Don Riggles
characters.notes: call-in guest. Imposter Don Rickles delivers 30-minute ass-obsessed roast, claims 120 years old, plugs fictional geriatric tour dates.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: field correspondent. Hosts Trent at the Movies, watches four trailers with Chris, argues for Monkey Man over Batman and defends green-screen safety.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: musical finale host. Performs Wendy's surge pricing song from the roof with lasers, features Hamburglar verse, rates Bruce Green, ends stream in rain.

storylines.beat: Crum and Munch debate with visible score graphic (78-70); Crum alleges rigging, Munch claims he can never lose; gambling debt subtext persists but no direct gorilla mention.

Hosts recurring 'Trent at the Movies' segment reviewing trailers; advocates for actor safety on green-screen volumes. [1:40:07]
Announced dynamic/surge pricing on Q4 2023 earnings call; Baconator price may double at lunch rush. [2:11:46]

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a streaming hiatus to anchor a broadcast dominated by an MIT mind-reading headset, a furry-favoring Munch & Crum debate, and Chet's musical rebrand. The night spirals into a 30-minute ass-centric roast from imposter Don Riggles, a trailer-review detour with Trent, and a DJ Newsic roof concert condemning Wendy's surge pricing — all while Case's impending move looms over the studio.
